description: For shared formulas \(A,B\) over any atom type with decidable equality, a supplied witness with middle formula \(I\) for \((\{N^-(A)\},\{N^+(B)\})\) yields proofs \(\{A\}\vdash r(I)\) and \(\{r(I)\}\vdash B\) in the existing classical natural-deduction calculus, with \(\operatorname{at}(r(I))\subseteq\operatorname{at}(A)\cap\operatorname{at}(B)\).
